report.summary: All five failures are timeouts (5 s Playwright limit) on pages that render /books, and they share one root cause: the seeded slow_list defect in app/main.py:159-161, which sleeps a random 0-8 s on every book listing. Fix this first by confirming whether BUGS=slow_list is set on the runner (the workflow file does not set it), then either unset it or remove the sleep; the UI tests should then stop timing out. Confidence is medium because the CI log does not show the environment variables.

causes.title: Random 0-8 s delay in list_books causes UI page loads and navigations to exceed the 5 s timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() sleeps for random.uniform(0, 8) seconds whenever the slow_list bug flag is enabled. Every server render of /books calls list_books (app/main.py:270 in render_books, and api_list_books at :213). The UI fixture sets a 5 s default timeout (tests/ui/conftest.py:7). When the random delay exceeds about 5 s, page.goto('/books') times out while waiting for the load event. When a click triggers a POST that redirects to /books (the login submit, or add book), the click times out while waiting for scheduled navigations. The outcome depends on chance, so the same code can pass on a rerun. Tests that also render /books but drew a short delay passed, for example test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui and test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf. The 5 failures out of 26 are consistent with this: a 3/8 chance per render of exceeding 5 s, though the count is only a rough fit.

app/main.py:159-161: def list_books(user_id): if "slow_list" in BUGS: time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
app/main.py:31: BUGS = {b.strip() for b in os.environ.get("BUGS", "").split(",") if b.strip()}
app/main.py:9-12 docstring: slow_list  random 0-8 s delay when listing books (flaky timing)
app/main.py:270 and 328: render_books calls list_books(user["id"]) on every GET /books and on the redirect after POST /books
tests/conftest.py:59: the app is started with uvicorn and inherits os.environ, so a BUGS variable set on the runner reaches the app
Not in evidence: .github/workflows/tests.yml sets no BUGS variable, so the flag must come from the runner or local environment. This is not confirmed by the logs.
causes.suggested_fix: First check whether BUGS=slow_list is set in the environment that produced this run. If it is, unset it for the CI test job. If the slow path is meant to stay as a seeded bug, the fix belongs in the app: remove or fix the random sleep in list_books. Don't just raise the 5 s timeout, because that only hides the defect. Optionally, add a test that asserts /books renders within a bound when slow_list is off.
